Project 01

Hotel Booking Cancellation Analysis

A business analysis project focused on understanding cancellation patterns, potential booking value at risk, and the signals that can support occupancy planning.

87,396bookings analyzed
24,025cancellations reviewed
~$11.48Mpotential booking value assessed

Business problem

Hotel teams need to understand which booking patterns are associated with cancellations so they can better anticipate demand, protect occupancy, and prioritize follow-up.

Analysis

  • Compared cancellation rates by hotel type, lead time, deposit type, market segment, and arrival month.
  • Applied data validation and statistical analysis to identify patterns and revenue exposure.
  • Built a Tableau dashboard for cancellation monitoring and occupancy planning.

Findings

  • Cancellation behavior varied across lead-time, deposit, market, and seasonal segments.
  • Longer lead-time bookings represented an important risk group for monitoring.
  • The analysis connected cancellation patterns to potential booking value rather than only counting records.

Recommendations

  • Prioritize proactive confirmation for higher-risk booking segments.
  • Use the dashboard to monitor cancellation patterns as booking mix changes.
  • Use risk signals to support occupancy planning and follow-up decisions.

Project 02

ChemCorp Business Analytics

A Tableau business analytics case study using revenue, profitability, product performance, and sector trends to identify where the business is performing and where it can improve.

Revenueperformance view
Profitmargin analysis
Sectorsbusiness comparison

Business problem

ChemCorp needs a clear view of revenue contribution, profitability, products, and business sectors so stakeholders can focus on high-performing areas and investigate underperformance.

Analysis

  • Built Tableau dashboards for revenue, profitability, product performance, and business-sector trends.
  • Evaluated revenue contribution and profit margin KPIs.
  • Translated dashboard findings into business insights and recommendations.

Findings

  • Performance differs across business sectors and products.
  • Revenue contribution and profit margin need to be reviewed together to avoid optimizing for sales alone.
  • The dashboard makes high-performing sectors and underperforming products easier to compare.

Recommendations

  • Protect and study high-performing sectors for repeatable growth patterns.
  • Review underperforming products for margin, demand, and portfolio decisions.
  • Use revenue and profit margin together as recurring management KPIs.

Project 03

AEMR Energy Analysis

An operational reliability analysis that separates outage frequency, energy loss, and outage duration so each problem is matched with the right action.

698forced events at AURICON
35,078 MWforced energy loss at GW
533 daystotal outage duration at MELK

Business problem

Energy reliability teams need to know whether the biggest problem is how often outages happen, how much energy each event loses, or how long the outage lasts.

Analysis

  • Analyzed electricity outage events using Tableau and Excel.
  • Evaluated participant-level performance across frequency, energy loss, and duration.
  • Built visualizations that support operational reliability recommendations.

Findings

  • AURICON is the priority for reducing forced outage frequency.
  • GW is the priority for reducing forced energy loss.
  • MELK is the priority for reducing prolonged outage duration.

Recommendations

  • Focus AURICON on recurring event prevention and root-cause work.
  • Focus GW on reducing energy lost per forced outage.
  • Focus MELK on shortening the duration of long outages.
